hypotheses.H1: Within algorithm and phase, root EGM improves paired out-of-sample prediction of sampled gradient-update norm over reward, raw advantage variance, and clip fraction.
hypotheses.H2: At matched rollout tokens and environment calls, failure-only retry plus solved retirement improves held-out success per million action tokens over symmetric low-signal resampling.
hypotheses.H3: For high-PAM/low-GSR roots, fresh-policy recollection improves stability-adjusted held-out success over wider PPO or DIS clipping at matched generated tokens.
hypotheses.H4: Root-level routing reduces the association between chunk count and selection probability while preserving or improving held-out reward.

sao_agentic_cell.model: open Qwen3-30B-A3B checkpoint or uniformly downsized preregistered substitute

evidence_boundary: Existing arithmetic PPO runs are instrumentation smoke tests only; they are not evidence for language-model PPO, SAO, or GLM-5.2.
